--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source_prologue ---
static float launchVelX, launchVelY, launchVelZ;
static float currentVelY;
static float particleLife, particleAge;
static float dragDecay = 0.9;
static float gravityY = -3.5;
static float dragRate = 10;
static float particleX, particleY, particleZ;
static float floorY = 0;
static float spawnDelay;
static float emitDuration = 6; // spout emission window (s); the clock loops at 2x this @tune
static float speed = 0.5;
static float detail = 30;
static float blowHoleX = 0.95, blowHoleY = 0.71, blowHoleZ;
static float waterDroplets = 250; // @tune

void computeVerticalMotion(ageSeconds, launchY) {
  // Velocity is linear in age: currentVelY = gravityY*ageSeconds + launchVelY.
  // Position is its integral:
  //   (gravityY/2)*ageSeconds^2 + launchVelY*ageSeconds + launchY
  // currentVelY is computed for illustration (the velocity term above);
  // only particleY is read by the caller.
  currentVelY = launchVelY + gravityY*ageSeconds;
  particleY = launchY + gravityY/2 * ageSeconds * ageSeconds + launchVelY * ageSeconds;
}

void computeLifespan(launchY) {
  // Solve particleY(age) = floorY for age: how long the particle takes to fall
  // from launchY to the floor. particleY is the projectile
  //   (gravityY/2)*age^2 + launchVelY*age + (launchY - floorY) = 0
  // a quadratic with a = gravityY/2, b = launchVelY, c = launchY - floorY, so
  //   age = (-b - sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a
  // Substituting a = gravityY/2: 4ac = 2*gravityY*c and 2a = gravityY.
  particleLife = (-launchVelY - sqrt(launchVelY*launchVelY - 2 * gravityY*(launchY - floorY))) / gravityY;
}

void computeDriftX(ageSeconds, launchX) {
  // Integral over [0, age] of the decaying horizontal velocity
  //   velX(s) = launchVelX * dragDecay^(dragRate*s)
  particleX = launchX + (launchVelX * pow(dragDecay, ageSeconds*dragRate) - launchVelX) / (dragRate*ln(dragDecay));
}

void computeDriftZ(ageSeconds, launchZ) {
  // Integral over [0, age] of the decaying horizontal velocity
  //   velZ(s) = launchVelZ * dragDecay^(dragRate*s)
  particleZ = launchZ + (launchVelZ * pow(dragDecay, ageSeconds*dragRate) - launchVelZ) / (dragRate*ln(dragDecay));
}

// bhX/bhY/bhZ: blowhole position in the whale's local frame (the globals
// blowHoleX/Y/Z, passed in -- named apart so they don't shadow).
// flukeAng/finAng are function-scoped locals: plain `float` inside the
// body, rebuilt every call, invisible to the rest of the scene. `detail`
// stays a global on purpose -- it is a scrubbable knob whose value has to
// survive between frames for the clamp below to hold it, not a temporary.
void drawWhale(bhX, bhY, bhZ) {
  float flukeAng, finAng;
  flukeAng = sin(speed*t*TAU)* 30;
  finAng = cos(speed*t*TAU)* 5;
  detail = max(12, floor(detail));

  // Shiny wet whale
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 100);

  // Main body: elongated ellipsoid, dark blue-grey on top
  glColor3f(0.24, 0.3, 0.4);

  glPushMatrix();
    glScalef(2, 0.85, 1.05);
    glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Belly: lighter, sits just under the body so it shows the underside
  glColor3f(0.72, 0.76, 0.78);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0.05, -0.42, 0);
    glScalef(1.65, 0.45, 0.75);
    glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail);
  glPopMatrix();

  glColor3f(0.24, 0.3, 0.4);
  glPushMatrix(); // begin tail
    glTranslatef(-1.85, -0.2, 0);
    glRotatef(flukeAng/2, 0, 0, 1);

    // Tail peduncle (narrow part before the flukes)
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(0.75, 0.3, 0.4);
      glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail);
    glPopMatrix();

    // Tail flukes -- two flat lobes, animated with flukeAng
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(-0.65, 0, 0);
      glRotatef(flukeAng, 0, 0, 1);
      glPushMatrix();
        glTranslatef(-0.1, 0, 0.55);
        glRotatef(15, 0, 1, 0);
        glScalef(0.35, 0.06, 0.65);
        glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail); // right fluke
      glPopMatrix();
      glPushMatrix();
        glTranslatef(-0.1, 0, -0.55);
        glRotatef(-15, 0, 1, 0);
        glScalef(0.35, 0.06, 0.65);
        glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail); // left fluke
      glPopMatrix();
    glPopMatrix(); // end flukes
  glPopMatrix(); // end tail

  // Pectoral fins
  glPushMatrix();
    glRotatef(finAng, 0, 0, 1);
    glRotatef(finAng/4, 0, 1, 0);

    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(0.45, -0.25, 1);
      glRotatef(25, 0, 1, 0);
      glScalef(0.4, 0.08, 0.45);
      glutSolidSphere(1, 14, 10); // right pectoral fin
    glPopMatrix();

    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(0.45, -0.25, -1);
      glScalef(0.4, 0.08, 0.45);
      glutSolidSphere(1, 14, 10); // left pectoral fin
    glPopMatrix();
  glPopMatrix(); // end fins

  // Eyes
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.04, 0.04, 0.04);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(1.45, 0.18, 0.63);
    glutSolidSphere(0.07, 10, 8);
    glTranslatef(0, 0, -1.26);
    glutSolidSphere(0.07, 10, 8);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Blowhole
  glColor3f(0.08, 0.08, 0.12);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(bhX, bhY, bhZ);
    glScalef(0.15, 0.04, 0.1);
    glutSolidSphere(1, 10, 8);
  glPopMatrix();
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -6.5500f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(20.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(-115.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
--- source ---

  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);
  glEnable(GL_POINT_SMOOTH);

  glColor4f(0.25, 0.45, 0.85, 0.46);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glDepthFunc(GL_ALWAYS);
  glPointSize(10);

  // Scene-looping trick: deliberately rewind the GLOBAL animation clock
  // every 2*emitDuration (~12s) so the spout replays on a loop. Heads-up
  // side effect -- this also resets t for replay and the Ctrl+T toggle,
  // since t is app-wide, not scene-local.
  if(t > 2*emitDuration) {
    t = 0;
  }

  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    for(i, 0, waterDroplets) {
      launchVelX = 3 * rand2(i,1);
      launchVelY = 2 + 2 * rand(i, 2);
      launchVelZ = 3 * rand2(i, 3);

      computeLifespan(blowHoleY);
      spawnDelay = 3 * rand(i,4);

      if((t - spawnDelay) > 0 && ( t <= ceil(emitDuration/particleLife)*particleLife + spawnDelay)) {
        particleAge = fmod(t - spawnDelay, particleLife);

        computeDriftX(particleAge, blowHoleX);
        computeVerticalMotion(particleAge, blowHoleY);
        computeDriftZ(particleAge, blowHoleZ);

        glVertex3f(particleX + 0.05, particleY, particleZ);
      }
    }
  glEnd();

  glDepthFunc(GL_LESS);

  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);

  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);

  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);

  drawWhale(blowHoleX, blowHoleY, blowHoleZ);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
